newsitem.title: POLAND: IB AUSTRIA SEES DROSED '96 NET PLN 5.6 MLN.
newsitem.headline: IB AUSTRIA SEES DROSED '96 NET PLN 5.6 MLN.

text.p: IB Austria Securities in Warsaw sees the poultry producer Drosed SA net down to 5.6 million zlotys in 1996 and up to 9.3 and 12.3 million in 1997 and 1998 respectively, IB Austria said in a report dated October 21.
Last year the company showed a net profit of 6.2 million.
IB Austria's forecast was higher than those of Drosed, which saw its net profit at 5.2 million zlotys this year and 8.6 million next year.
IB Austria said the forecasted fall in 1996 profit was due to Drosed's spendings on the Torun factory purchase, which, however, was likely to increase the company's sales in 1996.
IB Austria said it saw Drosed's sales rising to 137.2 million this year, 186.4 million next year and 226.7 million in 1998, up from 91.6 million in 1995.
"The leading position of the company in the sector and its strategy of aggressive expansion lets treat the company's shares as a good investment," the report said.
